descriptions.1: mag_anom - Magnetic anomaly - deviation from expected Earth's magnetic field
descriptions.2: rtp - Reduced to pole magnetic data - magnetic anomaly corrected for latitude effects
descriptions.3: tmi_hg - Total magnetic intensity horizontal gradient - rate of change in horizontal direction
descriptions.4: geod_2ndinv - Geodetic second invariant - measure of strain rate tensor magnitude
descriptions.5: iso_grav_anom_slope - Isostatic gravity anomaly slope - gradient of gravity after isostatic correction
descriptions.6: tc - Tilt angle or total curvature - magnetic field derivative for edge detection
descriptions.7: geod_shearrate - Geodetic shear rate - rate of angular deformation from GPS/InSAR
descriptions.8: geod_dilaterate - Geodetic dilatation rate - rate of volumetric strain (expansion/contraction)
descriptions.9: tmi_vg - Total magnetic intensity vertical gradient - rate of change in vertical direction
descriptions.10: deq_n100a15 - Distance to earthquake (n=100km radius, a=15° azimuth parameters)
descriptions.11: iso_grav_anom_vg - Isostatic gravity anomaly vertical gradient - vertical rate of change
descriptions.12: det_elev - Detrended elevation - topography with regional trends removed
descriptions.13: iso_grav_anom - Isostatic gravity anomaly - gravity after compensating for topographic mass
descriptions.14: tmi - Total magnetic intensity - total strength of magnetic field
descriptions.15: depth_to_base_surf - Depth to basement surface - thickness of sedimentary cover
descriptions.16: ieq_n100a15 - Earthquake intensity or density (n=100km radius, a=15° parameters)
descriptions.17: cond_surf - Conductivity surface - electrical conductivity of subsurface
descriptions.18: iso_grav_anom_hg - Isostatic gravity anomaly horizontal gradient - horizontal rate of change
descriptions.19: det_elev_slope - Detrended elevation slope - gradient of elevation after detrending

interpretation: Internal derivative consistency supports, but does not externally authenticate, the embedded band identities. Gradients scored only on pixels eroded 2 px from any invalid cell; no filling was used in features.
